caption: The drawing is a technical blueprint rendered in black ink on a yellowed, off-white background, depicting a rectangular window seat with the following views and details: a top view in the upper left showing a rectangular surface labeled "HAIRCLOTH COVER" with an ornamental turned spindle in the center; a side view at the lower left displaying the seat’s length (27 inches), a rounded or arched base with two curved supports meeting at a central circular rosette; an end view on the lower right showing the seat’s width (15 inches), the central turned spindle, and the arrangement of the legs with the height marked as 19 1/4 inches; and in the upper right corner, a detail labeled "DETAIL OF ROSETTE," illustrating a circular decorative element with concentric circles and a profile cross-section of its molding, measuring 3 inches in diameter. The drawing includes dimension markings throughout, written in both inches and fractional inches, with additional notes indicating the scale (1 1/2 inches) and project information in the upper right, which reads, "WINDOW SEAT IRVINGTON HOUSE BROOKLYN MUSEUM." Handwritten notes and numerical annotations are present along the left margin, and light stains or aging marks appear along the edges of the paper.
